detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall complete application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; confirm the intended admission cycle.

applicationFee.note: First-time international fee $30; domestic and international re-entry $25. University explicitly says it cannot offer fee waivers. Late applications incur a further $25.

english.note: Tests valid two years. Degree exemption requires primary English instruction at an accredited institution in a listed country; university may still request proof.

requirements.note: A prospective faculty advisor must agree to support the application before it is complete. GRE conflict: current doctoral-program directory says No GRE Required, while program landing page and the 2025 department letter request GRE scores; confirm directly before applying.

funding.note: 2025 international-applicant letter describes limited, competitive teaching assistantships with a target $20,000 doctoral stipend for nine months, tuition and most-fee waiver. International TAs were responsible for approximately $585 including health-insurance share; confirm current rates. The department says it rarely admits doctoral students it cannot fund; this is not an unconditional guarantee.
